releaseNotes: Extension manifest schema v1 (id, version, entry point, capabilities, assist flag).
Capability broker with first-release adapters: source-control.read and build.execute.
TypeScript extension runtime executed out-of-process over stdio NDJSON IPC.
Dual error logging architecture (user-facing sanitized stream and developer verbose stream).
Internal DEBUG-only scaffolding: SDKConfigStore, DirectServiceAccess, TestHarness, SandboxBypass (stripped from release builds).

SDK 1.1.0 (additive): 12 new capability IDs — db.ExploreView, ci.VisualWF, sandbox.view, use.SwiftCodeModel, terminal.sandbox, simulator.view, preview.live, uibuilder.open, symbols.browse, docs.search, dictionary.open, deviceconnect.open.
New IPC routes: ui.openView, cloudModel.complete, terminalSandbox.run. New TS exports: ScopesIDLists (SCOPES_ID_LIST), snippets (SNIPPETS), UIAPI, CloudModelAPI, TerminalSandboxAPI.
No removals or renames: 1.0.0 extensions keep working against the 1.1.0 host.

SDK 1.2.0 (additive): use.Security capability family — umbrella capability use.Security ("Use Security (Keychain)", high risk) plus five granular method-scope IDs (security.addValue, security.hasValue, security.listValueIDs, security.deleteValue, security.useValue) that are NOT separately grantable; host authorizes only the umbrella per call.

SDK 1.2.0 (additive): new capability IDs deployConsole.view (real Deployments console via the toolbar-notification bridge) and virtualization.view (virtualization console sibling opener); sandbox.view re-targeted to the real TerminalView sheet (full interactive shell — local shells, SSH nodes, themes).

New IPC routes: security.addValue, security.hasValue, security.listValueIDs, security.deleteValue, security.useValue. New error code: USER_CANCELLED (user dismissed the host secure prompt). New audit events: securityValueAdded, securityValueUsed, securityValueDeleted, securityValuesWipedOnUninstall, securityPermissionDenied (identifiers only, never secrets).
No removals, renames, or re-scopes: 1.1.0 extensions keep working against the 1.2.0 host.
